record.body:
## Problem

When a phase finishes green, handoff and chat surface a summary. The machine proof exists but is not assembled into one place a human can look at. Even with a stored packet, the dashboard must show it on phase detail or it will be missed.

## Approach

Orchestra owns packaging: project:proof-packet, handoff latest-proof, ## Proof on structured phases, execute-phase assembly after the gate, and a dashboard phase-detail Proof surface (Look + Attention + chip). Require the packet write; do not require signed_by or a Needs-you proof item in v1. Aff trail/audit pointers when a manifest exists. Decisions: proof-owner-orchestra, proof-packet-new-type, proof-gate-packet-not-signature, proof-dashboard-phase-detail.

Size: more than one. Human stops: none required for proof signature. Collision: contract + skills + dashboard/model and phase_screen share the proof-packet shape.

## Exit criteria

1. Contract lists project:proof-packet with agreed payload/kind/sections and handoff has latest-proof — design/resolved check.
2. settle-phase and plan-phase require ## Proof — skill tests.
3. execute-phase assembles/creates/prints the packet, refuses done without it, documents aff hooks — skill tests.
4. Dashboard phase detail shows Look and Attention from the latest proof-packet and a chip when present — dashboard tests.
5. Smoke: proof-packet at a real SHA has usable Look; handoff latest-proof and dashboard detail can surface it — adaptive-artifacts + dashboard model check.

## Proof

kind: claims
Looking means: open dashboard phase detail Proof (or the proof-packet Look section) for this phase at the phase-head SHA; re-run listed Machine commands if needed.

## Landing

branch: phase/phase-proof-packet
worktree: /home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/phase-proof-packet
base: main
close actions: commit code on the phase branch; merge that branch into main; commit the store on the primary checkout. Push is not a human stop for this run.

payload.title: Phase-end proof packet for human review
